scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const walk=d=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const p=path.join(d,f);const s=fs.statSync(p);if(s.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(p.endsWith('.map'))fs.rmSync(p)}};walk('dist')"
